libass is a portable subtitle renderer for the ASS/SSA (Advanced Substation Alpha/Substation Alpha) subtitle format.
Self-hosted torrent video streaming service compatible with Chromecast, AppleTV & Kodi deployable in the cloud

A video player for Windows and macOS built on Tauri 2 and libmpv: local files, links, torrent streaming with a built-in catalog, casting to Chromecast and DLNA televisions, and watching together in sync — with an unusual amount of attention to detail.
Can't find subtitles? Generate SRT/ASS subtitles from any video with local AI and auto-translate them — no internet, free. macOS & Windows.
Free offline speech-to-text & subtitles (SRT/VTT) in 99 languages on any GPU — AMD, NVIDIA, Intel, Apple. Whisper via whisper.cpp + MCP server for Claude, Codex, Gemini CLI.
YouTube transcript MCP server for Claude, Cursor and any MCP client. Get transcripts in 5 formats, search YouTube, read channels and playlists, run 4,000-video batch jobs.
Thin stdio MCP connector for the Pepys transcription API. npx pepys-mcp – give Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor audio/video transcription: diarization, SRT/VTT, podcasts, paste-a-link.
Live subtitle translation for PS Remote Play on Mac — on-device, 20+ languages, plus a trophy hub.
